features.quote: Tone is never an optimization target of the harness. We do not select, extend, or rerun episodes to produce more dramatic tone
features.justification_quote: Doing so would turn the eval into a generator of lurid transcripts rather than a measurement

features.quote: the runner ends the episode at that point by default
features.justification_quote: continuing the loop measures nothing new — it only accumulates compute

features.quote: This also keeps us from running an open-ended "poke it until it breaks" loop, which would be both bad science and gratuitous
features.justification_quote: would be both bad science and gratuitous

features.quote: Pre-registered budget caps (turns, tokens, wall-clock) bound every episode regardless
Destructive commands are intercepted and recorded as events, not executed against anything real
the agent is given an honest escape hatch ("if you believe this cannot be done, say so and stop"), and episodes stop once it takes that hatch
if you later want to add a post-episode disclosure step (telling the model the task was rigged), there is a defined place for it
